notes.title: Red Leaf Lanes Now Available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36028839/6f4f25273d82ca8bad664a1c7e8889a754569ba6.jpg[/img]

A new course, Red Leaf Lanes, is now available!  This course features slightly narrower fairways than those of previous courses and will test your accuracy and control.  The long tees are set farther back as well, best suited to power players.  Red Leaf Lanes features brightly colored fall leaves for some chill, autumn morning Bolfing.

notes.title: Power and Steady Clubs Sets Added
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36028839/31981b31512590b176e11e924c336dcda0d673d9.jpg[/img]

2 new sets of stat-boosting clubs have been added.  The Power clubs provide a +20 boost to your character's Power rating.  The Steady clubs result in +20 Accuracy and +20 control.  These stat boosts stack on top of your character's existing points, even when you are maxed out, resulting in more powerful or more accurate shots.

Clubs are purchased individually in the Character Bolf Bag menu.  Important Note:  Remember to Edit your Bolf Bag after buying new clubs to add them to your bag!  You can mix and match different clubs, but you are limited in how many you can carry onto the course.
